arguments.question: Assess ANET’s 5-, 21- and 63-completed-session market behavior versus SPY and XLK. Interpret trend, relative strength, volatility, drawdown/path risk, volume confirmation and plausible leadership-versus-rebound explanations using the supplied price, relative-strength and path panels. Report the deterministic historical conditional positive-return frequencies for every horizon with sample sizes, median and p10–p90 ranges, alongside unconditional base rates; explicitly label overlapping observations as dependent historical analogs, not calibrated forecasts. Give concrete completed-close or human-review reversal conditions and explain their consequence. Stop with the supplied deterministic panels; do not invent support/resistance or causal event attributions.
arguments.decision_impact: Provides the only permitted empirical probability language for near-term performance and identifies whether momentum is broad, extended or fragile relative to benchmarks.
